arxiv-2107-05151.title: Document Embedding for Scientific Articles: Efficacy of Word Embeddings vs TFIDF
arxiv-2107-05151.creator: H.J. Meijer, J. Truong, R. Karimi
arxiv-2107-05151.description: Abstract Over the last few years, neural network derived word embeddings became popular in the natural language processing literature. Studies conducted have mostly focused on the quality and application of word embeddings trained on public available corpuses such as Wikipedia or other news and social media sources.

arxiv-2111-01271.title: Brain dynamics via Cumulative Auto-Regressive Self-Attention
arxiv-2111-01271.creator: Usman Mahmood, Zening Fu, Vince Calhoun, Sergey Plis
arxiv-2111-01271.description: Abstract Multivariate dynamical processes can often be intuitively described by a weighted connectivity graph between components representing each individual time-series. Even a simple representation of this graph as a Pearson correlation matrix may be informative and predictive as demonstrated in the brain imaging literature.

arxiv-2304-09547.title: Graph Exploration for Effective Multi-agent Q-Learning
arxiv-2304-09547.creator: Ainur Zhaikhan, Ali H. Sayed
arxiv-2304-09547.description: Abstract This paper proposes an exploration technique for multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) with graph-based communication among agents. We assume the individual rewards received by the agents are independent of the actions by the other agents, while their policies are coupled.

arxiv-2510-14852.title: Unidirectional Zero Reflection and Perfect Absorption via Exceptional Points in Active Piezoelectric Willis Metamaterials
arxiv-2510-14852.creator: Hrishikesh Danawe, Serife Tol
arxiv-2510-14852.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hrishikesh Danawe, Serife Tol. Electro-momentum coupling in piezoelectric metamaterials with broken inversion symmetry enables asymmetric elastic wave transport by linking macroscopic electric fields to momentum, an effect analogous to Willis coupling in elastic media. A one-dimensional layered piezoelectric metamaterial integrated with shunt circuits, consisting of a resistor, inductor, and strain-proportional voltage feedback gain, is proposed to achieve dynamic control of frequency-dependent stiffness and damping through electromechanical interactions. Tuning the circuit parameters yields direction-dependent wave scattering at targeted frequencies.

arxiv-2512-20822.title: MediEval: A Unified Medical Benchmark for Patient-Contextual and Knowledge-Grounded Reasoning in LLMs
arxiv-2512-20822.creator: Zhan Qu, Michael Färber
arxiv-2512-20822.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to medicine, yet their adoption is limited by concerns over reliability and safety. Existing evaluations either test factual medical knowledge in isolation or assess patient-level reasoning without verifying correctness, leaving a critical gap.

pmc-11478989.title: Dietary Polyphenols as Anti-Aging Agents: Targeting the Hallmarks of Aging
pmc-11478989.creator: Ying Liu, Minglv Fang, Xiaohui Tu, Xueying Mo, Lu Zhang, Binrui Yang, Feijie Wang, Young-Bum Kim, Cheng Huang, Liang Chen, Shengjie Fan, Lindsay Brown
pmc-11478989.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Aging is a natural biological process influenced by multiple factors and is a significant contributor to various chronic diseases. Slowing down the aging process and extending health span have been pursuits of the scientific field. Methods: Examination of the effects of dietary polyphenols on hallmarks of aging such as genomic instability, telomere attrition, epigenetic alterations, loss of proteostasis, disabled macroautophagy, deregulated nutrient-sensing, mitochondrial dysfunction, cellular senescence, stem cell exhaustion, altered intercellular communication, chronic inflammation, and dysbiosis.

pmc-11645994.title: O039 Agreement between MotionWatch8 and Polysomnography sleep outcomes in Menopausal Women
pmc-11645994.creator: X Li, C Chow, M Halaki
pmc-11645994.description: IntroductionPolysomnography (PSG) is the gold standard for sleep measurement but is costly and can disrupt sleep. Actigraphy offers a non-invasive alternative for longer-term monitoring. This study aims to validate the MotionWatch8 device against PSG for sleep outcomes among menopausal women.MethodsSixteen healthy women aged 45-65 years with menopausal symptoms underwent four in-lab overnight PSG studies while wearing the MotionWatch8.

pmc-11713060.title: Blarcamesine in Early Alzheimer Disease Phase 2b/3 Randomized Clinical Trial
pmc-11713060.creator: Marwan N. Sabbagh, William R. Chezem, Kun Jin, Christopher U Missling, Anavex Life Sciences Research Group
pmc-11713060.description: BackgroundThere are no approved oral disease‐modifying treatments for Alzheimer disease (AD). This study was intended to assess efficacy and safety of blarcamesine (ANAVEX®2‐73), an orally available small‐molecule activator of the sigma‐1 receptor (SIGMAR1) designed to exert neuroprotection through restoration of cellular homeostasis including autophagy enhancement.

pmc-12595702.title: Integrating imaging and omics for enhanced subtyping of mild cognitive impairment associated with Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-12595702.creator: Sotiroula Afxenti, Margarita Zachariou, Efi Athieniti, Anastasia Lambrianides, Marios Pantzaris, George M. Spyrou
pmc-12595702.description: BackgroundMild Cognitive Impairment (MCI), considered the prodromal stage of Alzheimer’s disease (AD), is a heterogeneous condition characterised by mild but measurable cognitive decline. However, not all individuals with MCI follow the same trajectory—some remain stable, while others progress rapidly to AD.

pmc-13018642.title: Explainable AI for gastrointestinal lesion surveillance and precision targeted drug delivery
pmc-13018642.creator: Islam R. Kamal, S. F. El-Zoghdy, Randa F. Soliman
pmc-13018642.description: The Internet of Bio-NanoThings (IoBNT) promises revolutionary healthcare applications, particularly in targeted drug delivery. However, major challenges remain including safe nanodevice design, monitoring their behavior in biological environments and enabling reliable communication with external control systems. This work proposes an AI-assisted IoBNT architecture that combines gastrointestinal (GI) imaging with intelligent therapeutic supervision.

pmc-13054866.title: Synthesis and Antiproliferative Activity of Fluorinated N‑Acetylmannosamine Analogs
pmc-13054866.creator: Aleš Krčil, Lucia Šutvajová, Vojtěch Hamala, Ivana Císařová, Martin Kurfiřt, Lucie Červenková Št’astná, Jana Bernášková, Roman Hrstka, Jindřich Karban
pmc-13054866.description: Introducing fluorine into monosaccharides, or their incomplete acylation that leaves the anomeric group unprotected, can impart antitumor properties to the resulting glycomimetics. This property could be exploited in the development of new antiproliferative agents. Herein, we report the synthesis and antiproliferative activity of a complete series of deoxyfluorinated analogs of acylated N-acetylmannosamine (ManNAc) hemiacetals, which combine both aforementioned structural features.

pmc-13225019.title: Robotic retroperitoneal partial nephrectomy: rediscovering a proven approach in the era of minimally invasive surgery
pmc-13225019.creator: Michele Slawitz, Francesco Dinale, Annalisa Patera, Giulia Di Marco, Giulio Gaetano Guarino, Tommaso Bocchialini, Francesco Ziglioli, Davide Campobasso, Salvatore Micali, Umberto Vittorio Maestroni
pmc-13225019.description: Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) accounts for approximately 3% of all malignancies, with its incidence steadily increasing due to the widespread use of abdominal imaging techniques and the improved detection of asymptomatic renal masses. Traditionally, radical nephrectomy (RN) was considered the gold standard for the surgical treatment of renal tumors.

pmc-13274501.title: Digital Competence in Managing Digital Resources Among Health Professions Faculty in Ethiopian Public Universities: Implications for CME/CPD Digital Transformation
pmc-13274501.creator: Amare Equlinet Misganaw, Awoke Giletew Wondie
pmc-13274501.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Continuous medical education and continuing professional development (CME/CPD) have traditionally emphasised pedagogical effectiveness, yet the rapid digital transformation of health professions education now requires faculty to demonstrate advanced competencies in technology integration, digital resource management, accessibility, and online instruction. Faculty digital proficiency is increasingly essential for designing, delivering, and sustaining high-quality CME/CPD programmes that support workforce readiness and equitable access to learning opportunities. Evidence from resource-constrained settings remains limited.

pmc-13356032.title: Fracture morphology and multidirectional instability in failed closed reduction of pediatric supracondylar humerus fractures
pmc-13356032.creator: Muhammed Furkan Darilmaz, Mustafa Bulut
pmc-13356032.description: Purpose:To evaluate clinical and fracture-related factors associated with failed closed reduction in high-risk pediatric supracondylar humerus fractures (SCHF), with emphasis on fracture morphology and intraoperative multidirectional instability.Methods:This retrospective cohort study included 318 consecutive children aged 2–12 years who underwent surgery for Gartland type III SCHF or intraoperatively confirmed Gartland type IV instability between 2015 and 2025.

pmc-13406476.title: Staphylococcal Scalded Skin Syndrome in a Tertiary Pediatric Hospital over an 11-Year Period
pmc-13406476.creator: Magdalini Louka, Maria Lekaditi, Manthoula Valari, Filippos Filippatos, Athanasios Michos
pmc-13406476.description: Highlights What are the main findings? In this 11-year retrospective study conducted at a tertiary pediatric hospital, the incidence of staphylococcal scalded skin syndrome increased after 2017 and peaked in 2019, with half of all cases occurring during 2018–2019.Oxacillin resistance remained low and stable, whereas mupirocin resistance increased.
